decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 28th July 2017 and numbered 001, 25001, and location plan (unnumbered), and submitted 14th September 2017 and numbered 25002 Revision 2, therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - Before the development is first brought into use, a front boundary wall 600mm high and in brickwork shall be erected to the front elevation of the garden for the full width of the frontage, excepting a 3.5 metre wide gap where the existing vehicular access meets the site, as shown on drawing number 25002 Revision 2 (received 14th September 2017). This wall shall be permanently retained thereafter.
description: Conversion of garage into habitable room and erection of a single storey rear extension to the house
